description: Join Mike Walsh for Massachusetts Attorney General out on the campaign trail. From town halls and meet-and-greets to rallies and volunteer events, this is your chance to get involved, ask questions, and help build a movement for lower costs, safer communities, and honest, accountable government. Check the calendar below for upcoming events near you, RSVP to save your spot, and bring a friend. Together we can win this. We hope to see you soon.
title: EVENTS | Mike Walsh For Attorney General
